investigationQuestions: CRITICAL: NaiveReceiverPool.constructor writes state (NaiveReceiverPool.trustedForwarder, NaiveReceiverPool.feeReceiver) after external call to WETH.WETH. No reentrancy guard detected. Can the external call re-enter and exploit the stale state?

CRITICAL: NaiveReceiverPool.flashLoan writes state (NaiveReceiverPool.totalDeposits, NaiveReceiverPool.totalDeposits, NaiveReceiverPool.deposits) after external call to external.transfer. No reentrancy guard detected. Can the external call re-enter and exploit the stale state?

CRITICAL: PuppetPool.constructor writes state (PuppetPool.uniswapPair) after external call to DamnValuableToken.DamnValuableToken. No reentrancy guard detected. Can the external call re-enter and exploit the stale state?

Invariant [conservation]: NaiveReceiverPool.totalDeposits should equal the sum of all NaiveReceiverPool.deposits entries. Assertion: assert(totalDeposits == sum(deposits[*])). Threatened by: constructor, safeMint, constructor. Read the code to verify this holds and identify any violation path.

Invariant [solvency]: Contract's actual token/ETH balance should always be >= totalDeposits. Assertion: assert(token.balanceOf(address(this)) >= totalDeposits). Threatened by: flashLoan, withdraw, _deposit. Read the code to verify this holds and identify any violation path.

Invariant [no-profit]: A deposit of non-zero assets should always produce non-zero shares (prevents inflation attack). Assertion: assert(assets > 0 implies shares > 0). Threatened by: deposit, deposit, _deposit, calculateDepositRequired, calculateDepositOfWETHRequired, calculateDepositOfWETHRequired, deposit, depositFees, deposit, afterDeposit. Read the code to verify this holds and identify any violation path.

Invariant [access]: Admin-only functions (execute, withdraw, sweepFunds, proxyCreated, updateDelay, sweepFunds, sellOne, _offerOne, onERC721Received, flashLoan, borrow, flashLoan, emergencyExit, queueAction, cancel, setRate, onFlashLoan, checkFlashLoan, flashLoan, setFeeRecipient, execute, setPause, setUpgrader, rule, executeTokenWithdrawal) should revert when called by non-admin. Assertion: assert(msg.sender != admin implies revert). Threatened by: execute, withdraw, sweepFunds, proxyCreated, updateDelay, sweepFunds, sellOne, _offerOne, onERC721Received, flashLoan, borrow, flashLoan, emergencyExit, queueAction, cancel, setRate, onFlashLoan, checkFlashLoan, flashLoan, setFeeRecipient, execute, setPause, setUpgrader, rule, executeTokenWithdrawal. Read the code to verify this holds and identify any violation path.

Invariant [no-profit]: An immediate deposit-then-withdraw cycle should not yield profit for the depositor. Assertion: assert(balance_after_withdraw <= balance_before_deposit). Threatened by: stake, withdraw, withdraw, getLastWithdrawalTimestamp, withdraw, getLastWithdrawalTimestamp, _updateLastWithdrawalTimestamp, deposit, withdraw, redeem, withdraw, deposit, _deposit, calculateDepositRequired, calculateDepositOfWETHRequired, calculateDepositOfWETHRequired, deposit, withdraw, redeem, depositFees, deposit, withdraw, beforeWithdraw, afterDeposit, finalizeWithdrawal, executeTokenWithdrawal. Read the code to verify this holds and identify any violation path.
